question_text: What is 'amniocentesis'? Name any two disorders that can be detected by amniocentesis.

verification.note: Sourced from 'My Baby Bullet-Q — Senior Inter Zoology' (Star-Q Pass Track Series, Sri Publishers, 2022), book p.56, VSAQ 115. page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: What it is
steps.why: The fluid around the foetus carries its own cells, so testing the fluid tests the baby without touching it.
common_mistakes: Calling it a treatment. It is a diagnostic test.
Leaving out that foetal cells are tested.
steps.memory_tip: Amniotic fluid is drawn and the baby's own cells are tested.
steps.margin_note: Definition and how it is done.
lines: Amniocentesis is a diagnostic procedure to
detect genetic defects in the unborn baby.

steps.label: Two disorders
steps.why: All three are chromosome disorders, which is exactly what a test on foetal cells can show.
common_mistakes: Naming a disease that is not chromosomal.
Giving only one disorder when two are asked.
steps.memory_tip: Down, Edward's, Turner's — all chromosome disorders.
steps.margin_note: End with the misuse. It is a strong closing line.

lines.text: It is misused to learn the sex of the child

insider_note: The most repeated two-mark question in the paper — eight printed appearances. Two named disorders are compulsory; the misuse note is a good closing line.
